reason: The development-calibrated global raw-score cutoff improves development precision but fails evaluation recall, including a cross-file callee rationale and a new held-out contract. It is not enabled in production.

plan.hypothesis: Filtering low raw cross-encoder logits before the four-note cap reduces false positives without reducing per-query recall. Rank order, model batch, rendering, model assets, budgets and blend weights remain fixed.
plan.calibration: Use only the original 18-query corpus as development. Replay thresholds at every observed score boundary plus no-cutoff. Require each positive query to retain at least its baseline true-positive count. Maximize micro precision; break ties by retaining more true positives, then the lower (more conservative) threshold. If no threshold strictly improves precision, select no-cutoff and report no supported cutoff.
plan.selection: Threshold uses raw logits and is not a probability. Keep score >= threshold in the already computed blended order, then apply the existing four-note cap. Ordinary retrieval memories are unaffected.
validation: Eight-query exact-scope challenge, eleven-query pressure set and three-query diversity countercases: regression only, not calibration.
Eight new held-out synthetic queries across separate Python/JavaScript projects, not inspected until threshold freeze.
acceptance: All calls and tests complete, with unchanged off/counted results.
Strictly improve held-out precision while no evaluated positive query loses recall relative to no-cutoff.
Evaluate regression scores separately; do not tune the threshold on either evaluation set.
No strict same-ID requirement for equally relevant substitutions at a full cap; report every substitution.
plan.runtime_trial: Private isolated instrumentation exposes authorized candidate ID/title/raw score/order and reads GRAPHICLE_EVAL_SYMBOL_LINK_CUTOFF from a frozen wrapper executable. No production setting is added during evaluation.

selection.selection_rule: Maximize precision with no per-query TP loss; tie: more TP, then lower cutoff.

cross_file.explanation: The cutoff drops the relevant callee note while retaining the irrelevant caller note. Raw logits learned on other queries do not provide a reliable global relevance boundary.

diagnosis.broad_query: All six relevant candidate notes score approximately -11, below the cutoff. The four previously delivered notes all disappear.
diagnosis.heldout: The page-size contract scores -8.690524101257324 for a broad change question and disappears, despite being relevant.

validation.tests_note: Three final tests additionally verify refusal of held-out/mismatched calibration data and prevention of frozen-selection overwrite; calibration/runtime algorithms did not change after freezing.

limitations: All corpora are synthetic. New projects were held out only from cutoff selection, not independently labelled real-session data.
Threshold affects newly linked notes only, not memories selected by ordinary retrieval.
Scores are from one pinned model, input renderer and blend mode; they are not calibrated probabilities.
The failed threshold was not lowered or otherwise tuned using evaluation labels.
